label: Mangonel
description: One compact bucket-arm catapult, a warm oak rectangular four-wheel chassis with rope torsion bundle, stout throwing arm laid along the north-south axis ending in a broad wooden bucket with a stone, simple windlass and iron straps. Barrel-free silhouette: recognizable spoon catapult, not a gun or crossbow. Exactly THREE Classical crew in muted crimson tunics, bronze helmet crowns, leather belts and sandals, one on each side and one at the rear. Upright wheels appear as narrow top rims, no side-view spoked discs.

Keep the painted materials, recognizable Mangonel design, 3 crew, exact 1254 x 1254 transparent canvas, 2x2 equal cells and strict vertical overhead orthographic camera. No faces, upright wheel side discs or isometric walls.

Correct the mechanical orientation, not just the projectile: the throwing-arm torsion axle and padded stop crossbeam are toward NORTH/front; the long cocked throwing arm extends SOUTH/back from that axle with its loaded bucket or sling SOUTH of the pivot. Four subtle idle breathing poses with the mechanically corrected north-firing machine identical and centered in each cell. Scale down the full unit a little if needed to leave at least 35 pixels genuine transparent margin on every cell edge. Keep fully transparent clear middle gutters. No backgrounds, labels, smoke, projectile trails, grid lines or watermarks.
jobs.correction: north-firing geometry; cocked loaded arm extends south
